subject: MAP Draft & Target Close Alignment - FinTechCo
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintechco.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: MAP Draft & Target Close Alignment - FinTechCo

Thanks again for a productive call today, Samantha — appreciate the clarity on your performance and compliance priorities. Per our discussion, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures milestones, owners, dependencies, and a proposed target close. Key items for alignment: 

- Proposed target close: 2026-03-31 (end-of-month)
- Procurement / contract signature deadline: 2026-03-25 (to allow legal & procurement buffer)
- Milestones: PO & budget approval (FinTechCo) -> Technical POC (Redwood + FinTechCo SE) -> Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence exchange -> Contract redlines & signature
- Responsibilities: FinTechCo: budget & procurement, Redwood: MAP delivery, technical onboarding support (Neha), legal & contract coordination (Rishi & Lauren)
- Dependencies: SOC2 attestation and IP/BAA clauses; potential procurement window scheduled by your procurement team

Can you confirm the procurement signature deadline works for your team? If procurement needs an earlier date, we can iterate the MAP and shift milestones accordingly. Next step from our side: finalize the MAP (v1) and share to align owners/ dates. Attachment: 20260226-FinTechCo-MAP-draft.pdf

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintechco.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@fintechco.com>, procurement@fintechco.com
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP Draft & Target Close Alignment - FinTechCo

Thanks Camila — the MAP looks good and captures the flow well. Quick note from procurement: they are requesting a tighter signature deadline because our quarter close and vendor onboarding team require contracts to be fully signed by 2026-03-25. Can we update the MAP so the contract signature is on 2026-03-25 and the target close becomes 2026-03-29 to allow for onboarding steps after signature? 

I’m looping in Tom (procurement) and our procurement alias to confirm internal timelines — Tom, procurement, can you confirm the 2026-03-25 signature deadline is feasible on your end?

Best,
Samantha
Head of Product, FinTechCo
Samantha.Lee@fintechco.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintechco.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP Draft & Target Close Alignment - FinTechCo

Appreciate the heads-up, Samantha. We can accommodate the 2026-03-25 contract signature deadline, provided we get timely responses on: redlines from FinTechCo legal, SOC2 evidence request (we can send the report immediately), and any customization to commercial terms. Operationally, that means: 

- REDWOOD ACTIONS (if signature by 3/25): allocate legal resource to quick-turn redline review (Lauren), prioritize contract negotiation slots next week, and lock POC dates.
- FINTECHCO ACTIONS: provide initial redlines by 3/10 and sign internal procurement PO by 3/18 so procurement can finalize by 3/25.

If FinTechCo’s legal expects more time on redlines, we’ll need to discuss either a later signature date or a temporary SOW/PO arrangement to start technical work. Sam, can you confirm whether legal can provide redlines by 2026-03-10? If yes, we’ll move forward with the updated MAP and commit to the 3/25 signature target.

Thanks — Rishi
Director, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@fintechco.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintechco.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@fintechco.com
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP Draft & Target Close Alignment - FinTechCo

Hi all — confirmed from procurement: 2026-03-25 is the hard deadline for executing vendor contracts to meet our vendor onboarding in this quarter. We can prioritize Redwood but need the final commercial terms and any exhibits (e.g., data processing addendum) by 2026-03-15 to hit that signature date. Also, procurement needs the SOC2 report and standard security questionnaire completed by 3/10 to avoid delays.

Tom Alvarez
Senior Procurement Manager, FinTechCo
procurement@fintechco.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintechco.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@fintechco.com>, procurement@fintechco.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP Draft & Target Close Alignment - FinTechCo

Thanks Tom — that timeline is clear and actionable. I updated the MAP to reflect the procurement and signature deadlines and moved a couple of internal milestones to meet your constraints. Final agreed items below: 

- Target contract signature (hard deadline): 2026-03-25 (Procurement priority)
- Internal target close / go-live planning milestone: 2026-03-31 (onboarding sequence to start after signature)
- Key milestone dates: Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence: by 2026-03-10 (Redwood to send SOC2 report + Neha to run the security Q&A session on 3/5); Commercial terms/exhibits to FinTechCo legal by 2026-03-12 (Rishi & Lauren)
- FinTechCo commitments: initial redlines by 2026-03-10; PO/approval by 2026-03-18
- Dependencies: timely legal redlines & procurement approvals; any additional security requirements may impact signature timing

Next steps (action owners):
- Camila: share updated MAP (attached) — 20260302-FinTechCo-MAP-final.pdf
- Rishi & Lauren: prep commercial exhibits and be on standby for redline turnaround by 3/12
- Neha: schedule security Q&A with FinTechCo for 2026-03-05
- Samantha/Tom: confirm internal calendar to deliver redlines by 3/10 and PO by 3/18

Please reply-all to confirm and I’ll lock the MAP in HubSpot and send a DocuSign package for signature scheduling. Appreciate everyone’s responsiveness on this — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Best,
Camila
Camila Reyes | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Attachment: 20260302-FinTechCo-MAP-final.pdf
